ideas.pitch: An offline-first patient triage and vitals monitoring app designed for rural Indian clinics with intermittent internet connectivity, featuring local AI pre-screening and automated syncing.
ideas.title: ArogyaSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the HealthTech Innovation track with a practical, localized solution for rural healthcare infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision platform that analyzes traditional medicinal herbs and leaf specimens via smartphone camera to verify authenticity, active compound levels, and pharmacological safety.
ideas.title: AyurVision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge AI with traditional Indian wellness domains, aligning well with the HealthTech track judges looking for localized impact.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent patient flow and bed-allocation predictor for overcrowded government hospitals in India, utilizing historical admission rates to optimize emergency ward triage.
ideas.title: MediQueue AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a massive, visible operational bottleneck in Indian public healthcare, a guaranteed interest point for local healthcare judges.

ideas.pitch: A regional dietary tracker and personalized meal recommendation engine optimized specifically for affordable, locally available Indian staples and traditional grains.
ideas.title: NutriJan
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges nutrition tech with domestic Indian dietary habits, scoring high on relevance and accessibility for the HealthTech track.

ideas.pitch: A contactless photoplethysmography (rPPG) web app that measures heart rate and estimated blood oxygen levels simply using a standard laptop or smartphone webcam.
ideas.title: TelePulse Vitals
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases impressive computer vision capabilities directly within the HealthTech track without requiring specialized medical hardware.
